package: 9-terminal LGA_CAV 4.72 x 3.76 x 1.00 mm, bottom port (LCSC: SMD-9)

1.name: SCK
1.hint: 64 SCK cycles per WS frame (fSCK = 64 × fWS), SCK 0.5-3.2 MHz, WS 7.8-50 kHz (p. 5, 11); no active clocks while VDD is off – the ESD diodes conduct (p. 10)

needs.source: InvenSense INMP441 data sheet DS-INMP441-00 Revision 1.1 (05/21/2014), Table 6 p. 8 and p. 11: the SD trace should have a 100 kΩ pull-down resistor to discharge the line while all microphones have tri-stated their outputs ('a 100 kΩ resistor is sufficient')

4.name: L/R
4.hint: low: the microphone sends in the left channel, high: in the right (Table 6)

needs.source: InvenSense INMP441 data sheet DS-INMP441-00 Revision 1.1 (05/21/2014), Table 6 p. 8: decouple VDD to pin 6 with 0.1 µF; p. 15: 0.1 µF ceramic X7R or better between pin 7 and ground strongly recommended, as close to pin 7 as possible

8.name: CHIPEN
8.hint: low (ground): power-down; high (VDD): enabled (Table 6); do not switch between standby and power-down directly (p. 10)

hints: Bottom port: the PCB needs a sound hole under the port – not smaller than 0.25 mm, 0.5-1 mm recommended – and no solder paste on it (p. 17).
No washing water on the port, no blow-off or ultrasonic cleaning; no vacuum pick-up on the bottom side (p. 18).
The 7-inch reel INMP441ACEZ-R7 is 'to be discontinued' (p. 1, 20); LCSC and JLCPCB list 0 pcs (2026-10-31).

compliance.source: InvenSense INMP441 data sheet DS-INMP441-00 Revision 1.1 (05/21/2014), p. 1: RoHS/WEEE compliant, halide free; LCSC product data C5438445 (2026-10-31): RoHS

sources: mpn, manufacturer, footprint, jlc_class, pin numbers and names: EasyEDA library data of C5438445, https://easyeda.com/api/products/C5438445/components?version=6.4.19.5, read 2026-10-31 (edakit part import)

InvenSense INMP441 data sheet DS-INMP441-00 Revision 1.1 (05/21/2014), read from LCSC's copy (sha256 ddcc8ac55f9f…, 21 pages, names INMP441, edakit part fetch 2026-10-31); TDK's download page https://invensense.tdk.com/en-us/download-resource/ds-inmp441-00-inmp441-datasheet renders its link in the browser only

Table 1 p. 4: supply voltage 1.62 … 3.63 V (the pin table says 1.8 V to 3.3 V); supply current normal mode 1.4 / 1.6 mA at 1.8 V, 2.2 / 2.5 mA at 3.3 V (typ / max) – idd_max_a is the 3.3 V maximum; standby 0.8 mA max; power-down 2 µA (1.8 V), 4.5 µA (3.3 V) max
Table 2 p. 5: VIH 0.7 × VDD min, VIL 0.25 × VDD max on L/R, WS, SCK (characterization, not production tested); no thresholds for CHIPEN
Table 3 p. 5: SCK 0.5 … 3.2 MHz, high/low ≥ 50 ns; WS 7.8 … 50 kHz
Table 4 p. 6: VDD −0.3 … +3.63 V; digital pin input voltage −0.3 V … VDD + 0.3 V or 3.63 V, whichever is less (vin_rel_max_v 0.3, pin v_max_v 3.63); biased temperature −40 … +85 °C
Figure 3 and Table 6 p. 8 (bottom view): 1 SCK, 2 SD (tri-state), 3 WS, 4 L/R, 5 GND (ring around the port), 6 GND, 7 VDD, 8 CHIPEN, 9 GND
p. 11: I2S slave, 24-bit two's complement, SD tri-stated outside its channel, 100 kΩ pull-down on SD; Figure 7: 0.1 µF at VDD
p. 15 Power-Supply Decoupling; p. 17 land pattern (pads 0.40 × 0.60 mm, pitch 1.05 mm, 2.66 mm between rows, sound hole); p. 19 outline, height 0.88 / 0.98 / 1.05 mm (body h_mm = max)

roles bclk, ws, sd as named by the net fn i2s.bclk, i2s.ws, i2s.sd (handbook 3, circuit.FN_LINES); no pin functions: functions is an MCU's pin mux – on this slave it would satisfy REQ.function on the net by itself
LCSC product data C5438445 (2026-10-31): 0 pcs, product cycle 'normal', no end-of-life note; JLCPCB (edakit stock, 2026-10-31): Extended Part, 0 pcs

InvenSense INMP441 data sheet DS-INMP441-00 Revision 1.1 (05/21/2014), p. 4 Table 1: supply current normal mode at VDD = 3.3 V 2.2 mA typ., 2.5 mA max. – icc_a = 2.5 mA (behaviour logic); p. 11: 'The output data pin (SD) is tri-stated when it is not actively driving I²S output data' – SD rests released
notes: I2S MEMS microphone (slave), bottom port. Data sheet and LCSC do not say end of life; the data sheet says only that the 7-inch reel INMP441ACEZ-R7 is to be discontinued.
